title: Intensive Advanced Korean II
description:
Prerequisite: Must have appropriate World Language Placement (WLP) score, and permission of ARHU-School of Languages, Literatures, and Cultures department.
Restriction: Must not be a native/fluent speaker of Korean. Native/fluent speakers of Korean or students who have previously attended Korean school should take the WLP and see the Korean Program Advisor to identify the correct Korean course for which to register. This course is designed to enable learners to achieve speaking, listening, reading, writing, and grammar skills in Korean at an advanced level (intermediate mid or high on the OPI scale). This course will also help the students understand aspects of the Korean culture. Thereupon, it will help students understand how Korean language and culture are interrelated with each other and how they can utilize the Korean language appropriately according to cultural expectations in real-life situations.
